name: Unstoppable Magic
text: **Unstoppable Magic**: Humans from civilizations built upon advanced magic, such as Geb or Nex, are educated in a variety of ways to accomplish their magical goals. They gain a +2 racial bonus on caster level checks against spell resistance. This racial trait replaces the bonus feat trait.
